must_have: buildable or residential land only for land listings

assumptions: No sub-agents were spawned; coverage counts refer to single-agent portal-by-portal passes using the skill fallback.
municipality_only includes municipal parts explicitly shown by portals as part of Třebechovice pod Orebem, including Krňovice and Polánky nad Dědinou.
Chalupa is treated as an input-only house-like category and normalized to house when retained.
gaps: Local curl-based helper scripts could not fetch portal pages in this environment due DNS/network failure, so verification used web search/open results instead.

A supported iDNES category result showed a buildable 1003 m2 land listing in Štěnkov for 4 985 000 Kč, but no supported direct detail URL was accessible, so it was excluded under the skill rule requiring traceable detail-page URLs.
RealityMix direct opens for some detail URLs returned cache misses, but matching iDNES detail/category pages provided enough verified fields for retained merged house listings.
Several exact-municipality listings were excluded because land area was below 1000 m2, price was unavailable, property type was unsupported, or land use was agricultural/non-residential.
